description: Election Commission - A member has Vacated his Office of member of the Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice specifically declares that a member of a local authority (Arachchikattuwa Pradeshiya Sabha) has vacated their office due to ceasing membership in a political party. This falls under electoral processes and related matters as it concerns the status of an elected official under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance, making it an Elections Gazette (Type 7).
